title: vegetarian chili
ingredients: 1 (28 oz) can diced tomatoes; with juices
2 (15 oz) cans black beans; rinsed and drained
1 (15 oz) can pinto beans; rinsed and drained
2 Tbsp fresh cilantro; chopped, plus more for serving
1-2 tsp sherry vinegar, red wine vinegar, or lime juice
optional toppings; avocado, tortilla chips, sour cream, grated cheddar, cilantro, lime wedges
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion, bell pepper, carrots, celery, and half the salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are tender and the onion is translucent, about 7-10 minutes.
Add garlic, chili powder, cumin, smoked paprika, and oregano. Cook while stirring constantly until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, black beans, pinto beans, broth, and bay leaf. Bring to a simmer, then cook gently for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove bay leaf. Transfer about 1 1/2 cups of chili, including some liquid, to a blender and blend until smooth. Return to the pot. An immersion blender or potato masher works too.
Stir in cilantro, vinegar or lime juice, and remaining salt to taste. Serve with toppings.
notes: Makes 4 large or 6 moderate servings. Keeps well in the fridge for about 4 days and freezes well. Start with less chili powder if using a hot pure chile powder instead of a mild American chili powder. Adapted from Cookie and Kate: https://cookieandkate.com/vegetarian-chili-recipe/
